name: sfx.freesound-search
title: Sound search (Freesound)
summary: The Freesound provider of sfx.search: search Freesound's recorded sound effects and ambiences, filtered by licence and length, and list candidates with their licence, author and a preview link. Needs the freesound_api_key secret file and network access.
description: Runs a Freesound text search (API v2) and returns the candidates in the sfx.search shape, plus Freesound's own fields (downloads, rating). Licence codes map to Freesound's licence filter (cc0 = Creative Commons 0, by = Attribution, by-nc = Attribution NonCommercial, sampling+ = Sampling+); min_seconds and max_seconds become a duration range. `filter` adds any raw Freesound filter (for example `samplerate:48000` or `tag:foley`), and `sort` picks the order. Reads the freesound_api_key secret file (an API key from freesound.org/apiv2/apply); the key is sent only in the Authorization header to the API and never appears in results or logs. Retries 429, 5xx and network errors. Freesound matches EVERY word of a query, so a long query can find nothing where a shorter one finds plenty: a query of several words that finds nothing returns a warning saying so. With `fewer_words: true` such a search is repeated with the last word dropped each time ("woman grunt effort short", then "woman grunt effort", "woman grunt", "woman"), with the same filter, sort, limit and page, until one finds sounds; `query_used` names the query the sounds came from, and a warning names both queries. Put the words that matter most first. Bring a pick into a job with sfx.fetch (provider freesound).

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, for example "wooden door creak".

limit.description: How many candidates to return at most (one Freesound page). Default 15.

min_seconds.description: Keep only sounds at least this long.

max_seconds.description: Keep only sounds at most this long.

licenses.description: Keep only sounds under these licences: cc0, by, by-nc, sampling+. Omit for every licence.

filter.description: Extra raw Freesound filter terms, added to the licence and length filter, e.g. "tag:foley samplerate:48000".

sort.description: Result order: score (best text match, Freesound's default), rating_desc, downloads_desc, duration_asc or _desc, created_desc or _asc. Omit for score.

page.description: Which page of results (of `limit` each). Omit for the first.

fewer_words.description: What to do when the query finds nothing. false (default): one search, exactly as written. true: search again with the last word dropped each time, down to the first word alone, until a search finds sounds; the filter, sort, limit and page stay the same. A "quoted phrase" counts as one word. At most one extra request per dropped word. The result's query_used names the query that found the sounds; ask for further pages with that query.

id.description: Freesound sound id; pass it to sfx.fetch.

license.description: Licence code: cc0, by, by-nc, sampling+ or other.

author.description: The Freesound user who uploaded it.

preview.description: Link to the high-quality MP3 preview a human can play.

downloads.description: How often it was downloaded, when Freesound reports it.

rating.description: Average rating 0..5, when Freesound reports it.

total.description: How many sounds match query_used in all of Freesound.

query_used.description: The query these sounds are for: the query as written, or the shorter one that found sounds when fewer_words searched again. Still the query as written when no search found anything.

warnings.description: Anything worth knowing about the search: that nothing matched (and, for a query of several words, that fewer words may), or that a shorter query was used.

examples.title: A calm room tone, best rated first
